text: Rule 7.2 (d), amendment 1 (one fixed re-measurement, approved by the user after the development first-call ratio of B/10/10/bt was 1.1006 against the 1.10 limit). For each persona file (development and held-out), run the TIMING block of evaluate_recommender 5 separate times (separate processes, each with its 21 alternating repetitions, ABBA order), for the frozen candidate B/10/10/bt (its result serves the -opp fallback too, as before), with the frozen link file of that persona file. Take the median of the 5 ratios for each of: first call (limit 1.10) and recommend() with the index built (limit 2.00), compared at full precision. Pass only if all four medians (2 files x 2 ratios) are within their limits. Measured once. No further re-measurement. If it fails, task 4 stops and A0 stays. The persona guard results already in build/gap_eval/final_r3/guards/ stay as they are; only the timing part is replaced by this rule.
source: User decision in chat, 2026-11-21, answering "Re-measure the speed check with one fixed, longer test and continue if it passes?": the user agreed; the answer was given in Arabic and means "yes, fine, I agree" (the original words are recorded in hardest/user_decisions_r2.md). The user was told the protocol: 5 separate measurements, take the median; if it is under the limit the final measurement continues, if it is over, task 4 stops for good; this is a change to how speed is measured, made after seeing the result. The result seen: the development first-call ratio of B/10/10/bt was 1.1006 against the 1.10 limit (build/gap_eval/final_r3/guards/dev.json). Record: hardest/user_decisions_r2.md.
